title: Question 21
passage:
Could our team keep the portable speaker until noon?
A. The microphone is in the same case. B. The trainers need it at eleven, so you’ll have to bring it back before then. C. We can order another one next month.
passageZh:
我們小組可以把攜帶式喇叭借到中午嗎？
A. 麥克風也在同一個箱子裡。 B. 訓練人員十一點要用，所以你們得在那之前歸還。 C. 我們下個月可以再訂一台。
